item.title: Tired of Waiting for npm install? Bun 1.3 Does It in 8 Seconds
item.description: Bun 1.3 packs a runtime, package manager, bundler, and test framework into a single executable. A large Remix project that takes npm 3 minutes 20 seconds to install? Bun does it in 8 seconds. Built-in SQL client, Redis client, zero-config frontend dev -- here's what actually changed.

item.title: We Compared 6 Outage Reports Before We Understood What Async Rust Actually Prevents
item.description: CPU was fine, memory was stable, no recent deploys — but error rates hit 3.4%. After comparing 6 outage reports across Node.js, Go, and Java, we finally understood how async systems actually fail, and where Rust+Tokio's compiler draws the line.

item.title: The Middleware Optimization Trick That Made My Node.js Server 40% Faster
item.description: Learn this middleware design pattern to dramatically boost Node.js performance, reduce latency, and improve scalability without rewriting your code

item.title: I Fired My Entire Node.js Stack — Rust Rebuilt It in 3 Weeks (The Ugly Truth)
item.description: API latency dropped from 850ms to 8ms, monthly costs from $12,000 to $900. Sounds great? The price was three months of hell and a team on the verge of collapse. This is a real backend migration story.
